usageNotes: This endpoint upgrades an HTTP connection to a WebSocket tunnel for a node-level VNC console session. It must be called after obtaining a VNC ticket and port from the node's VNC proxy endpoint (e.g., POST /nodes/{node}/vncproxy); the ticket is short-lived and single-use. The caller must perform the WebSocket upgrade handshake — this is not a standard JSON REST call and returns null on success.

examples.summary: Open VNC WebSocket for node console using ticket from vncproxy

tips: Always call the node's vncproxy endpoint first to obtain both the port and vncticket before calling this endpoint.
The vncticket is single-use and expires quickly; initiate the WebSocket upgrade immediately after receiving it.
This endpoint must be used with a WebSocket client — a plain HTTP GET will not establish a usable session.
Requires Sys.Console on /system; API tokens are permitted (allowtoken: true).
